content.thinking:
The parallel fuzz runs interfered with each other! They all write to the same files `m.json` and `fz.jsonl` in the shared WORK directory (`wmanifest` writes to 'm.json' and `wf('fz.jsonl', ...)`). So concurrent processes overwrote each other's manifests/logs. That's why the diagnostics look completely unrelated to the printed logs.

I need to make the fuzzer use unique file names per process. Let me fix the harness to include a per-process suffix (PID or a passed-in tag), then re-run in parallel.

content.text: The parallel runs shared the same scratch filenames and overwrote each other. Let me make the harness process-safe and re-run:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('harness.py').read()
src = src.replace("""def wf(name, data):
    path = os.path.join(WORK, name)""",
"""TAG = '-%d' % os.getpid()

def wf(name, data):
    path = os.path.join(WORK, name + TAG)""")
open('harness.py','w').write(src)
EOF
rm -f t/*.json t/*.jsonl; for seed in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do python3 fuzz_replay.py $seed 60 & done; wait
